changes.why: v0.20.0 removed R.commute, deprecated since v0.19.0 for sequence
v0.20.0 removed R.commuteMap, deprecated since v0.19.0 for traverse
v0.20.0 filters the shorter list against the longer, so the elements and order follow the shorter list: intersection([3, 2], [1, 2, 3]) is [3, 2], was [2, 3]
v0.20.0 keeps the shorter list's elements that match the longer: intersectionWith(mod3, [4, 5, 7], [1, 2]) is [1, 2], was [4, 5]; the postcondition changes with it
v0.20.0 stops at Math.min(keys.length, values.length): extra keys are ignored where they were undefined values; the precondition |keys| <= |values| is dropped, results on the old domain unchanged
v0.20.0's merge is _objectAssign({}, l, r) instead of mergeWith: the revealed body is a + b, with the same results
v0.20.0's mergeAll is _objectAssign over the list instead of reduce(merge, {}): the revealed body is its own recursion, with the same results
new in v0.20.0 (@category Function): a function returning the spec's object of each function applied to its arguments; flat spec, unary here
new in v0.20.0 (@category Relaction, i.e. Relation): value restricted to [min, max], throwing for min > max
new in v0.20.0 (@category List): the elements grouped by keyFn, each group folded with valueFn from valueAcc
new in v0.20.0 (@category Logic): fn applied to init until pred holds; bounded by an extra fuel here
